references.title: Galatians 4, World English Bible
references.scope: Primary translated chapter consulted, particularly verses 6, 16-19. The inward-formation interpretation is a comparison, not a claim that the chapter states a modern neural theory.

references.title: Romans 12, World English Bible
references.scope: Primary translated chapter consulted for mind renewal, embodied and communal conduct, and responses to enemies. Passage wording is distinguished from the constructive interpretation.

references.title: Philippians 2, World English Bible
references.scope: Primary translated chapter consulted for Christ-oriented disposition, attention to others and the relation of willing to divine action. No modern cognitive mechanism is attributed to the text.

references.title: Jeremiah 31, World English Bible
references.scope: Primary translated verses 31-34 consulted in their Israel/Judah restoration setting. No compositional date or physical manuscript date is inferred from this modern translation.

references.title: Ezekiel 36, World English Bible
references.scope: Primary translated verses 24-28 consulted for new heart and spirit, conduct and restoration to land. The collective setting is preserved, not reduced to private psychology.

references.title: SN 22.59, Thanissaro Bhikkhu translation
references.scope: Primary translated discourse consulted for not-self reasoning about the five aggregates, change, affliction and control. Brief paraphrase only; no asserted Buddhist-to-Christian transmission or identity with SAN.

references.title: Farb and colleagues, Attending to the present (2007)
references.scope: Author-affiliated institutional abstract and bibliographic record consulted; DOI 10.1093/scan/nsm030. Supports the narrative/experiential task distinction, not verification of Christic formation or a no-self doctrine.

references.title: Weng and colleagues, Compassion Training Alters Altruism and Neural Responses to Suffering (2013)
references.scope: Primary research article and its indexed abstract/results consulted; DOI 10.1177/0956797612469537. The comparison is short-term compassion versus reappraisal training and a subsequent redistribution task, not clinical efficacy of Christian practice.

references.title: Maoz, Yaffe, Koch and Mudrik, Neural precursors of decisions that matter (2019)
references.scope: Primary full-text HTML abstract, task description and results consulted; DOI 10.7554/eLife.39787. Deliberate versus arbitrary donation choices constrain generalization from readiness potentials, not proof of uncaused will.

references.title: University of Michigan, P46 leaf: Hebrews 1:7-2:3
references.scope: Institutional item record consulted: P.Mich.inv. 6238, Greek, approximate date 180-220 CE, unknown provenance within Egypt, acquired 1930/1931. The selected leaf is Hebrews, not a photographed Galatians 4 passage. No scan reuse claimed.

references.title: Yale University Art Gallery, Dura-Europos Christian Building
references.scope: Institutional excavation/conservation narrative consulted for font and paintings. Its older house-church account is compared with both 2024 archaeological interpretations, not treated as a settled construction/function chronology. No images copied.

references.title: David K. Pettegrew, Rethinking the archaeology of the Christian Building (2024)
references.scope: Published abstract and bibliographic metadata consulted, not the paywalled full article. Proposes retained domestic use and an earlier construction date. Published online June 11, 2024; American Journal of Archaeology 128(3), 341-379.

references.title: Camille Leon Angelo and Joshua Silver, Debating the domus ecclesiae at Dura-Europos (2024)
references.scope: Primary full-text HTML consulted, especially abstract and archaeological context; DOI 10.1017/S1047759424000126. Distinguishes renovated space from domestic antecedents, questions the 232/233 construction inference and places sealing in 254-256 CE. No meshes or figures reused.

references.title: Library of Congress / Israel Antiquities Authority, Community Rule 4Q258
references.scope: Institutional catalogue and displayed translation scope consulted. Broad late-first-century-BCE/early-first-century-CE copy date is not converted into an invented numerical interval. This selected 4Q258 record is not a direct collation of 1QS III-IV.
